segments.text: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
segments.translation: 帕特里克为什么不停地问同样的问题？

segments.text: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
segments.translation: 前首相温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的选举中落选了。

segments.text: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
segments.translation: 他现在正退出政治生涯，出国了。

segments.text: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
segments.translation: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生的激进进步党的狂热反对者。

segments.text: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
segments.translation: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

segments.text: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
segments.translation: 当他问莱恩先生是否住在那里时，值班警察告诉他，前首相落选后出国了。

segments.text: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
segments.translation: 第二天帕特里克又去了那所房子。

segments.text: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
segments.translation: 同一个警察正慢慢走过门口，帕特里克又问了同样的问题。

segments.text: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.
segments.translation: 虽然这次有点怀疑，但警察还是给了他同样的回答。

segments.text: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
segments.translation: 第三天，帕特里克又去了那所房子，问了完全相同的问题。

segments.text: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted,
segments.translation: '我昨天和前天都告诉你了，'他喊道，

segments.text: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
segments.translation: 他已退出政治生涯，出国定居了！'

segments.text: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'
segments.translation: '我知道，'帕特里克回答说，'但我喜欢听你这么说！'
